name: Harmony 16 Third Chain Keller
summary: Major and minor chords alternate, each built on the third of the one before, so neighbors always share two notes. With scenes, the window slides one key at a time and can tour all twelve keys. Source: Callipari, Illustrierte Harmonie, p. 62–65, 123–125; Lizzio, Chord Progression Codex, p. 198–199, 323
